name: Волшебник
original_text:
Посмотрите карты на руке другого игрока и выберите 1 из них. Либо заплатите её стоимость в банк и немедленно постройте её, либо заберите себе на руку.

Вы можете строить одинаковые кварталы.
specific: Elderly man with receding white hair, white beard and orange robe with cream lining and ornament, smoking a bent brown pipe with white smoke, right hand gripping twisted dragon-shaped wooden staff, left palm open below small cross-shaped golden light, dark archway and gray background. Preserve masculine face, age, small light and staff form; do not intensify glow. Preserve the fine horizontal divider between the two ability paragraphs.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: complete Russian Citadels Deluxe CHARACTER game card.
EDIT the single original card provided as the ONLY edit target and reference. Faithful artistic upscale/restoration: remove scan blur and JPEG artifacts, restore sharp painterly brush texture and readable native typography in the original traditional illustration style. Preserve the exact identity, face, sex, age, expression, body and hand pose, costume, props, all existing background objects, perspective, composition, original card proportions and full edge-to-edge rectangle. Preserve title banner, rank badge, bottom parchment scroll, every symbol, separator and layout. Do not crop, pad, add borders or external margins. Do not redesign.
Color: approximately 10% less intense than the original, restrained soft contrast; same palette family, light levels and shadow atmosphere. Do not strengthen golden glow or highlights. No photorealism, 3D, HDR, hyperrealism or oversharpening.
This is a CHARACTER card: add no district coins or color medallions, new objects, characters, decorative fields, watermarks or text.
Text: render every Russian word and punctuation verbatim, preserve ё, numbers and original bold/italic emphasis and paragraph count. Reflow minimally only to fit the original same bottom parchment region. Keep exact native decorative serif typography; no translation or paraphrase.
Card-specific visual invariants: Elderly man with receding white hair, white beard and orange robe with cream lining and ornament, smoking a bent brown pipe with white smoke, right hand gripping twisted dragon-shaped wooden staff, left palm open below small cross-shaped golden light, dark archway and gray background. Preserve masculine face, age, small light and staff form; do not intensify glow. Preserve the fine horizontal divider between the two ability paragraphs.
Exact rank badge: 3.
Exact title: «Волшебник».
Exact ability text (2 paragraphs separated by the original horizontal ornament):
Посмотрите карты на руке другого игрока и выберите 1 из них. Либо заплатите её стоимость в банк и немедленно постройте её, либо заберите себе на руку.

Вы можете строить одинаковые кварталы.

qa.name: pass: exact source title visually checked
qa.rank: pass: exact source rank visually checked
qa.text: pass: each word, ё, numbers, punctuation and paragraph count visually compared to source
qa.composition: pass: major pose, costume, props and background retained; fine details generatively reinterpreted
qa.identity: pass: face, sex, age and expression retained with painterly reinterpretation
qa.color: same palette and restrained contrast; exact 10% reduction unmeasured
qa.layout: pass: complete card, original title/rank/ability regions and separators retained

limitations: Generative restoration can reinterpret fine details and face nuances.
Approximately 10% lower color intensity is a prompt target, not a measured guarantee.
Raw generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; no resize, crop, padding, compression or game asset replacement.
